mechanics.claim: The shield triggers on Camille's next basic attack on-hit against an enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against an enemy champion grants her a {{tip|shield}}

mechanics.claim: The passive goes on cooldown only after the shield expires or is destroyed, not on trigger.
mechanics.quote: ''Adaptive Defenses'' goes on cooldown after the shield expires or is destroyed.

mechanics.claim: The shield blocks exclusively physical or exclusively magic damage, chosen based on the target's dealt damage type and Camille's current armor/MR.
mechanics.quote: absorbing damage from either exclusively {{tip|physical damage|{{as|physical damage}}}} or {{tip|magic damage|{{as|magic damage}}}}

mechanics.claim: The passive will not trigger or go on cooldown if the attack is dodged, blocked, or Camille is blinded.
mechanics.quote: ''Adaptive Defenses'' will not trigger or go on cooldown if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or if '''Camille''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
